ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה נָתַן לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף מָקוֹם לָגוּר וְלַעֲבֹד.
ideas.children_en: Joseph's family came to Goshen in Egypt to raise sheep. Pharaoh gave them the best land. Joseph showed only some brothers to Pharaoh so they wouldn't be soldiers and could work peacefully.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב סִפֵּר עַל חַיָּיו הָאֲרֻכִּים, וְיוֹסֵף דָּאַג לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob met Pharaoh and said his age and that he had hard life. Joseph gave them a good place to live and fed everyone during famine.

ideas.children_he: בִּזְמַן רָעָב אֲנָשִׁים נֶאֱלָצִים לְוַתֵּר עַל רְכוּשָׁם כְּדֵי לֶאֱכֹל.
ideas.children_en: The famine was bad. Egypt sold grain for money, then for animals. Joseph made sure those who could not pay got food by taking their animals.

ideas.children_he: הָרָעָב הָיָה כָּל כָּךְ קָשֶׁה שֶׁאֲנָשִׁים אִבְּדוּ אֶת אַדְמָתָם וְאֶת חֵרוּתָם.
ideas.children_en: When people could not pay, they sold themselves and their land for bread. Joseph bought all land for Pharaoh, except the priests' land.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף אִרְגֵּן זְרָעִים וּמָזוֹן, אֲבָל הָאֲנָשִׁים נִדְרְשׁוּ לְשַׁלֵּם חֵלֶק מִיְּבוּלָם.
ideas.children_en: Joseph gave seeds to the people. They gave Pharaoh a fifth of the crops. People thanked Joseph for saving them and agreed to be Pharaoh’s slaves.

ideas.children_he: מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב הִמְשִׁיכָה לִגְדֹּל בְּמִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob and his family, called Israel, lived comfortably in Goshen and grew many. Jacob lived in Egypt 17 years and 147 years in all.
Jacob knew he would die soon and asked Joseph not to bury him in Egypt but in his ancestors' place. Joseph promised to do so.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִבְטִיחַ לְכַבֵּד אֶת בַּקָּשָׁתוֹ שֶׁל אָבִיו.
ideas.children_en: Jacob asked Joseph to swear the promise. After Joseph swore, Jacob thanked him and bowed down though he was sick.
